note: Fleet address book, A2A allowlist, AND fleet-ctl roster. spawn/cwd drive start; parked suppresses watchdog death alerts + boot-restore. controller=true marks agents allowed to run fleet-ctl self-initiated. parent kai has spawn=null — fleet-ctl restarts it by capturing its live cmdline.
acctNote: MAC ONLY. acct = the Anthropic account label this agent runs on (a file name under ~/.config/claude-accounts/). Written by a dashboard or /account switch, read by macctl start: it injects CLAUDE_ACCT_LABEL + CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from that store, so a crash heal or a reboot brings the agent back on the SAME account instead of reverting it to the ambient login. null or absent = whatever the launcher happens to be authenticated as. The token is never stored here, only the label; the spawn line cats it inside the spawned shell.
quietMirrorsNote: A2A pairs whose owner mirror ping is OFF by default. Each entry is '<from>><to>'; '*' matches any agent. Read by the SENDER at send time and stamped into the envelope, so both ends agree. send_to_agent quiet:true/false overrides per message; priority:'high' always mirrors. Suppresses the Telegram ping ONLY — delivery, inbox, outbox.jsonl, receipts and the UNTRUSTED tag are unaffected.

laptop.note: cross-machine A2A: fleet-relay scp's envelopes to peer:fleetRoot/<to>/inbox over tailscale; needs passwordless ssh key both ways
